entities.name: N-phthalimidopropoxy quinolinone
observations: Reactant decodes to Cn1c(=O)ccc2cc(OCCCN3C(=O)c4ccccc4C3=O)ccc21, containing an N-substituted phthalimide-protected 3-aminopropoxy group.
The quinolinone-like core and aryl ether are retained in the transformation.

entities.name: 3-aminopropoxy quinolinone
observations: Product is the free primary amine analog, with the terminal substituent converted from –N-phthalimide to –NH2.

entities.name: Hydrazine
observations: Hydrazine (NN) in ethanol, with water present, is recorded in the closest exact database matches for this transformation.
Hydrazine is the likely deprotection reagent for phthalimide hydrazinolysis.

entities.name: Phthalimide hydrazinolysis
observations: Cleaves the terminal N–C(=O) bond of an N-substituted phthalimide to release a primary amine.
Closest matched record reports hydrazine in ethanol/water and 77% isolated yield.
